designTarget.name: frappe
designTarget.note: The shell covers Frappe Desk 16.50 and later. It is not locked to 16.50. v16.52 is a supported release and the default dock profile, because it is the latest release measured here. Set data-dock=v16.50 when the app still ships that dock.

extractedFrom.note: Custom properties below are the first declaration in each file (light :root). Dark overrides live in the same files under [data-theme=dark] and are not duplicated here.

btnHeightLegacy.note: Legacy Desk control. Espresso .es-button sm is calc(var(--spacing)*7) = 28px.

frappeUi.note: Desk sidebar is 224px (14rem). Pass width="224px" on frappe-ui Sidebar. The 15rem default is 240px.
